fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. (V) has risen 28.4% over the past year, significantly outperforming the financial transaction services industry (+10.5%), with digital transactions and cross-border payment growth strengthening its competitive position.
fields.summary_ko.1: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. (XOM) has risen 12.6% over the past 6 months due to low-cost production and expansion in Permian and Guyana, though commodity price volatility and energy transition remain risk factors.
fields.summary_ko.2: Pfizer Inc. (PFE) has risen 22.8% over the past year but lags the industry (+33.7%), with revenue pressure from patent expiration and loss of exclusivity on key products remaining a concern.
